page.overview:
What is Bulk Bricks?

Bulk Bricks is a theme which includes one type of brick, in large quantities. There is a large variety of pieces available in Bulk Bricks, and the theme consists of 141 different sets so far. The theme had subtheme piece sets for Castle, Seasonal, Space, TECHNIC, and Trains respectively.
